status: Complete52,184byte implementation review; transfer candidates recorded, not all implemented.

insights.detail: Select users are replaced using facts at each instruction/PHI incoming edge, rather than replacing the definition globally. Phi common-value elimination also requires dominance and nonpoison checks.
insights.ink: Scope candidate derivation to exact guarded uses; whole checked expression proves removal. Do not turn one branch fact into a function-wide assumption.

insights.detail: constantFoldCmp excludes AssumeInst uses when replacing a comparison.
insights.ink: Keep explicit proof premises as obligations; deriving a fact from a premise must not erase the obligation needed to justify that fact.

insights.detail: Ranges and individual predicates remove unreachable cases; default removal needs complete range coverage. Successor multiplicities and dominator updates account for shared targets.
insights.ink: General enum/match simplification can be knowledge-driven, but complete arm coverage and source exhaustiveness must remain explicit; pure tests alone do not authorise removal of fallible outcomes.

insights.detail: Saturating/overflow operations become ordinary arithmetic only after guaranteed no-wrap regions cover operands. Signed and unsigned flags are separate.
insights.ink: Reusable laws for checked/saturating arithmetic under explicit bounds are worthwhile; preserve zero-divisor/overflow results and wrapping language semantics. Never import LLVM flag authority.

insights.detail: Unsigned ranges simplify x/y to0 or1 and x%y to x or x-y when ranges prove at most one subtraction. Signed narrowing accounts for the newly introduced MIN/-1 corner case; width is never reduced below8 and profitability is assumed by this pass.
insights.ink: Investigate database quotient/remainder laws under checked ranges. Requires auditing Ink division semantics and bitvector support first; no new primitive/op recogniser solely to mimic LLVM.

insights.detail: Remainder expansion freezes potentially undef operands before duplicating uses.
insights.ink: Total pure scalar values are stable but expressions with effects, errors, allocations or callbacks require separate evaluation-order/ownership preservation. Do not transfer the transform to actions blindly.

insights.detail: Sign domains permit signed-to-unsigned arithmetic/comparisons, arithmetic-to-logical shifts and sext-to-zext. Integer-to-float conversion equivalence also depends on nonnegativity.
insights.ink: Retain explicit types, bit widths and FP conversion rules; pursue exact proof-backed cross-width laws rather than backend reinterpretation shortcuts.

insights.detail: Expensive no-wrap fallback examines at most4uses and skips same-block/PHI uses; all relevant uses must justify flags.
insights.ink: Use bounded, demand-driven analysis and diagnostics; a checked selected candidate can exploit guarded uses, but skipping a use cannot certify a global property.

insights.detail: processAnd requires a low contiguous mask and an unsigned maximum not exceeding that mask, excluding undef.
insights.ink: Matches the new general low-mask law: mask shape is an explicit checked condition. Arbitrary numerical bounds do not justify removing arbitrary bit masks.

insights.detail: Preorder reachable traversal simplifies earlier blocks before expensive dependent queries. Return summaries require exact definitions, union all returns and intersect existing attributes; empty/constant summaries are treated separately.
insights.ink: Consider parent-first bounded candidate simplification; summary reuse must bind exact definitions, captures and all return paths.

insights.detail: The pass deliberately abandons LazyValueAnalysis even when preserved because retaining it costs memory and invalidation work.
insights.ink: Measure whether reuse beats recomputation before adding persistent caches; bounded invocation-local scopes currently avoid stale shared fact state.

remaining: Candidate list is not completion. Division, overflow, sign conversions, switch/match, whole-definition summaries and use-scoped profitability still require Ink counterpart audit, proof authoring and broad measurements.
